DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: マリナ、どうしたの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 山海経の玄武商会というところに来ているんだが

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 少し困っていてな

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 良ければ助けてもらえないか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: すぐ行くね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 食べ過ぎたせいか

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 少し、お腹が……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ……大丈夫？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ああ、ひとつ確実な学びを得たぞ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 食べ物の味と見た目は、必ずしも一致しないようだ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 実は、あの虫の串焼きって観光客向けなんだけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それならそうと早く言ってくれ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 着いたぞ、先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: どこにいる？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ごめん、5分くらい遅れそう！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 大丈夫だ、気を付けて来てくれ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 広場で待っている

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……大変だった

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: でも、すごくきれいだったよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: お、お世辞はやめてくれ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……お世辞じゃないとしたら、それはもっと困る

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: はぁ、いろんな人から写真集の感想が届いてるな

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 念のために聞くが、先生は買ってないな？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 待て、なぜ何も言わない？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生！？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: これから行く喫茶店の名前が思い出せなくてな……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 「桃源郷」だよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ああ、そうだったな

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 山海経のお茶はどんな味なのか

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: なかなか楽しみだ

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 지금, 산해경의 현무상회라는 곳에 와 있는데.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 한 가지는 확실하게 배운 것 같다.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 음식의 겉모양이, 반드시 맛과 일치하지 않는다는 것을.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 그 벌레 꼬치 말인데, 관광객한테만 파는 거래.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 왜 그런 말을 지금 해 주는 건가!

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 미안, 마리나! 5분 정도 늦을 것 같아!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 빈말이라도 그런 말은 하지 말아 주었으면 하는데.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 벌써부터 여기저기에서, 사진집 잘 봤다는 연락이 들어오고 있으니까…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 혹시나 해서 묻는 건데, 선생은 사지 않았겠지?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 오늘 가기로 한 찻집 이름이 뭐였지?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei...?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Hi, Marina. What's up?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'm at this place called Black Tortoise Promenade in Shanhaijing.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I've found myself in a...troublesome situation.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It's rather shameful, but I require your assistance.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'll be right there!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Maybe I ate too much, but...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: ...my stomach hurts.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: ...Are you okay?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I've learned one thing for certain.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: A food's appearance does not necessarily correlate with its taste.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You know, they only sell those bug skewers to tourists.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Why would you wait until now to bring that up?!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Where are you?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I've arrived.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Sorry, Marina! I'm running a little late! Just five minutes!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: By that much is fine.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I will wait for you at the plaza.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: ...What a troublesome experience.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: But you looked really good!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Even if it's just empty words, you shouldn't speak like that.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: ...And your infraction is even worse if they weren't empty words.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'm already receiving messages from various sources, saying they liked the photo album...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Just to confirm, you didn't purchase it, did you?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Wait. What's with that "dot, dot, dot"?!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei?!?!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: What is the name of the teahouse we intend to visit today?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I think it was Peach Blossom Spring.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Right.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'm curious just how delicious Shanhaijing's tea truly is.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Hm. I'm looking forward to it.

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู...?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: โอ้ มารินะเหรอเนี่ย มีอะไรเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ตอนนี้ฉันอยู่ที่ย่านการค้าเทพเต่าดำ
ของซานไห่จิงน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: มีเรื่องน่าตกใจเกิดขึ้นนิดหน่อย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถึงมันจะน่าอาย แต่ฉันอยากขอให้ช่วย
สักหน่อย...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูจะไปหาเดี๋ยวนี้แหละ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เป็นเพราะกินเยอะเกินรึเปล่านะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: รู้สึกเหมือนจะปวดท้องชอบกล...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เป็นอะไรรึเปล่า...?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แต่มีสิ่งหนึ่งที่ฉันได้เรียนรู้มาแล้วละ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
หน้าตาของอาหาร ไม่เหมือนกับรสชาติ
ของมันเสมอไป

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ได้ยินว่าแมลงเสียบไม้นั่นจะขายให้
เฉพาะนักท่องเที่ยวด้วยน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ทำไมถึงเพิ่งมาบอกกันเล่า!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถึงไหนแล้วน่ะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฉันมาถึงแล้วนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
โทษที มารินะ! ครูน่าจะไปถึงช้าสัก
5 นาทีนะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แค่นั้นไม่เป็นไรหรอก

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งั้นฉันจะรออยู่ที่จัตุรัสนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เป็นประสบการณ์สุดช็อกจริงๆ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: แต่ก็เข้ากันได้ดีเลยนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถึงคุณครูจะพูดแบบขอไปที ฉันหวังว่า
คุณครูจะไม่พูดแบบนั้นอีกนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าไม่ได้พูดแบบขอไปทีจะยิ่งแย่
เข้าไปใหญ่...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
หลายๆ คนโทรมาบอกว่าพวกเขา
ชอบโฟโต้บุ๊คกันมากๆ เลยน่ะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันแค่ถามเฉยๆ นะ คุณครูคงไม่ได้ซื้อ
มาหรอกใช่มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เดี๋ยวก่อน ส่งแต่จุดมาแบบนั้น
หมายความว่าไง?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ครู?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู?!?!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ร้านน้ำชาที่เราจะไปวันนี้ชื่ออะไรนะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: น่าจะร้านนิทานดอกท้อนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ใช่แล้วละ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ชาของซานไห่จิงจะรสชาติยังไงนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อืม ฉันคาดหวังมากเลยนะ

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我現在在山海經一個叫做「玄武商會」的地方

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 雖然有點難為情，希望能請老師幫個忙……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不知道是不是吃太多的關係……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那就是食物的外觀，未必與味道相符

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 聽說那些炸蟲串，好像是專門賣給觀光客的

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 這種事為什麼現在才說！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 抱歉，瑪麗娜！我可能會遲到5分鐘！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 就算是客套話，也請別這麼說

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 已經有一堆人聯絡我，說看過那本寫真集了……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 以防萬一確認一下，老師應該沒有買吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 等一下，這個沉默是什麼意思？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 今天約好要去的茶館叫什麼名字？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 啊啊，確實是這個名字沒錯

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不知道山海經的茶味道怎麼樣
